effects: Moves `amount` LsETH (the vault collateral 0x8c1B…6549) from the signer to the vault through transferFrom, using up the signer's LsETH allowance to the vault.
Mints vault shares (rLsETH, the vault's own ERC20) to `onBehalfOf`. The number of shares is worked out from the vault's active stake and shares at the time of the call.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 LsETH into the vault, with the shares credited to the beneficiary address that is shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of rLsETH shares minted to the beneficiary is not shown, because it comes from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_)`. VaultTokenized.deposit emits `Transfer(address(0), onBehalfOf, mintedShares)`. The descriptor shows only `#.amount` and `#.onBehalfOf`.
findings.fix: None needed. The shares depend on the vault's state, not on the calldata.

effects: Burns the signer's active rLsETH shares, enough to cover `amount` (previewWithdraw rounds up).
Queues `amount` LsETH in next epoch's withdrawals and gives the right to claim it to `claimer`, not to the signer. The queued amount can be slashed until it is claimed.
Nothing is paid out now. The LsETH can be claimed only after the next epoch ends (epochs are 7 days).
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of 2.5 LsETH from the vault, claimable by the 'Claim owner' address.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of rLsETH shares burned from the signer is not shown, because it comes from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake())`. VaultTokenized._withdraw emits `Transfer(msg.sender, address(0), burnedShares)`.
findings.fix: None. The amount comes from the vault's state.

findings.title: withdraw: the requested LsETH can be slashed before it is claimed, so the claimer may receive less.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol onSlash lowers `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]` and `withdrawals[currentEpoch_]`. withdrawalsOf then prices the claim from the reduced `withdrawals[epoch]`.
findings.fix: Optionally add 'subject to slashing' to the label of the requested amount.

effects: Burns `shares` rLsETH vault shares from the signer's active balance.
Queues the matching amount of LsETH (worked out from storage) in next epoch's withdrawals and gives the right to claim it to `claimer`. The amount can be slashed until it is claimed.
formats.shown: Queue 0.987654321123456789 rLsETH of vault shares for withdrawal, claimable by the 'Claim owner' address.

findings.title: redeem: the LsETH amount queued for the claimer is not shown, because it comes from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares())`, then `_withdraw(claimer, withdrawnAssets, shares)`.
findings.fix: None. The amount depends on the vault's state.

effects: Uses up the signer's withdrawal claim for `epoch` (it is marked as claimed).
Sends the signer's whole matured withdrawal for that epoch, in LsETH, from the vault to `recipient`. The amount comes from storage.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal for epoch 42 to the recipient address that is shown.

findings.title: claim: no part of the screen names the asset paid out (LsETH).
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. Descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawal' and interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'. No field names a token.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Claim LsETH withdrawal' and 'Claim LsETH from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the LsETH amount sent to the recipient is not shown, because it comes from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _claim: `amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)`, which is priced from withdrawalSharesOf, withdrawals and withdrawalShares in storage.
findings.fix: None. The amount is not in the calldata.

effects: Uses up the signer's withdrawal claim for every epoch listed.
Sends the total of the signer's matured withdrawals for those epochs, in LsETH, from the vault to `recipient` in one transfer. The amount comes from storage.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals for epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the recipient address that is shown.

findings.title: claimBatch: no part of the screen names the asset paid out (LsETH).
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. Descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawals' and interpolatedIntent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'. No field names a token.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Claim LsETH withdrawals' and 'Claim LsETH from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total LsETH sent to the recipient is not shown, because it comes from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i])`. _claim reads `withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)` from storage.
findings.fix: None. The amount is not in the calldata.
